In an online meeting, you are one speaker again: everything your microphone hears reads as 我.

**Your mic is one speaker** (#694)

- In an online meeting, Parley no longer tries to tell voices apart on your microphone. Short lines from one person on a laptop mic were being split into several speakers that swapped back and forth line after line. Every line from your mic now reads as 我, during the meeting and after it's saved.
- The other side of the call is still told apart, so several people on it still show as 遠端 1, 遠端 2.
- A meeting recorded with the microphone only, such as several people around one laptop in a room, still separates the voices on the mic.
